name: SE Ranking
one_liner: SE Ranking offers a REST API for SEO and AI search data, plus an MCP server for AI assistants.
auth_notes: API key is used in the Authorization header with the Token scheme.
access_notes: API key can be generated in the dashboard; free trial provides 100K credits and MCP access.

evidence.snippet: SEO API by SE Ranking: SEO & GEO Data at Scale
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model or agent to access your SE Ranking data in a simple and secure way.
First, you’ll need to generate a unique API key from your account dashboard.

Standout feature: It is the only server in this list that pairs a full Data API, covering keyword, backlink, audit and AI-search visibility data, with Project write actions such as creating audits, adding keywords and managing AI Result Tracker prompts, over one approve-to-connect hosted URL.
The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as MCP server access.

notes: No SDKs or webhooks are provided; the API is RESTful and rate‑limited to 10 requests per second.
